Explain how sound localization is perceived and implemented in XR, including the minimum audible angle, spherical coordinate parameters, and ILD/ITD cues.
Describe how head-related transfer functions are used to synthesize binaural sound for XR systems, using average-listener HRTFs when individual HRTFs are impractical.
Summarize the main points of the lecture.
